name: census-geocode
keywords: convert addresses to latitude and longitude

interface.longDescription:
Geocode a list of US business addresses to latitude and longitude, county, census tract and block group, with congressional and state legislative districts, in an Excel file.

Paste one address per line or CSV text with an Address or Street header. The downloadable XLSX and CSV files include the input rows and columns, with match status, matched address, coordinates, county and FIPS, tract, block group and block GEOIDs appended. XLSX cells are capped at Excel's 32,767-character limit; the CSV keeps input values in full. District lookup adds congressional and state legislative districts, school districts and places. Filter, search and sort the address preview, copy coordinates, and download the results.

Supports nonprofit grant applications and address-list operations. Up to 1,000 addresses for coordinates and tracts, or 100 with districts, with a 200,000-character input limit. A 1,000-row list may take about 30 seconds, or longer when the service is slow.

Coverage: US address ranges in the 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico and covered island areas. Coordinates are interpolated street points and may be tens of meters from a building. PO boxes, rural routes and new streets may not match. Check changed matches. Districts use current boundary files, including the 120th Congress and 2026 state legislative districts as of October 21, 2026; they do not identify elected representatives. Service errors appear by row and successful chunks remain available. Generated files are kept for one hour for their download links.

pl-PL.subtitle: Geografia adresów w USA
pl-PL.description: Geokoduj listę adresów w USA do współrzędnych, hrabstw, obwodów i okręgów. Pobierz XLSX i CSV z zachowaniem kolumn. Limit: 1000 adresów lub 100 z okręgami. Pliki wygasają po godzinie.

de-DE.subtitle: US-Adressen geokodieren
de-DE.description: US-Adresslisten in Koordinaten, Countys, Zählbezirke und Wahlbezirke umwandeln. XLSX und CSV behalten die Eingabespalten. Bis zu 1000 Adressen oder 100 mit Wahlbezirken. Dateien bleiben eine Stunde verfügbar.

es-ES.subtitle: Geografía de direcciones US
es-ES.description: Convierte direcciones de EE. UU. en coordenadas, condados, zonas censales y distritos. Descarga XLSX y CSV conservando las columnas. Hasta 1000 direcciones o 100 con distritos. Archivos disponibles durante una hora.

fr-FR.subtitle: Géocoder des adresses US
fr-FR.description: Convertissez des adresses américaines en coordonnées, comtés, secteurs de recensement et circonscriptions. XLSX et CSV conservent les colonnes. Limite de 1000 adresses ou 100 avec circonscriptions. Fichiers disponibles une heure.

ja-JP.subtitle: 米国住所の地理情報
ja-JP.description: 米国の住所一覧から座標、郡、国勢調査区、選挙区を検索します。元の列を保持したXLSXとCSVをダウンロードできます。上限は1000件、選挙区付きは100件です。ファイルは1時間保存されます。

pt-BR.subtitle: Geografia de endereços dos EUA
pt-BR.description: Converta endereços dos EUA em coordenadas, condados, setores censitários e distritos. Baixe XLSX e CSV preservando as colunas. Até 1000 endereços ou 100 com distritos. Arquivos disponíveis por uma hora.
